text: Four DROPPED words, gone from the rewrite: D1 (box-curl arrow)(mbox-cross arrow); D2 (fishhook bx)(wave+curl bx); D3 (egg seed)(mbox-sweep seed); D4 (crook seed)(mbox-cross+loop bx).
